effect_description_eng:
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a purple card is placed under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and memory +1.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you would play 1 level 4 or higher Digimon card with [Bagra Army] trait, by placing up to 3 purple Digimon cards from under your Tamers in the digivolution cards of the Digimon card played, reduce the memory cost of that Digimon by 2 for each card placed.
